domains: eight subscales: Self-Care, Food Preparation, Home Management, Communication, Financial Management, Leisure, Shopping, Mobility; two measurement constructs: visual field or scotoma (24 items) and visual acuity (22 items)
response_scale: 4-point difficulty: 1 = unable, 2 = very difficult, 3 = moderately difficult, 4 = not difficult; not applicable allowed (treated as missing)
scoring: Rasch rating scale model (Andrich); person measures in logits per construct, anchored to item parameters from the validation study (Smith 2019)
target_population: clients with low vision from various eye diseases, home health or outpatient OT rehabilitation
notes: Client-reported; responsiveness shown here (paired t, Cohen's d, SRM; p5-6). Fit, item hierarchy and DIF in Smith 2019 (not this paper). Items listed in Table 1 p4. Two Leisure items can also serve Communication (p3).
